title: Timeframe for application.
officialText:
The application for the certificate of occupancy must be submitted within six months of the final construction inspection. The department may refuse to issue a certificate of occupancy where the final inspection was completed more than six months prior to such application.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
